solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Not belonging to but devoted to the United Nations

parts.note: UN is the standard abbreviation for the United Nations
to be attached to someone is to be fond of or devoted to them

explanation.surface: A diplomat who claims independence yet is loyal to the UN.
explanation.walkthrough: The abbreviation comes first in the answer although the clue names it last; 'but' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unattached is free of ties, not belonging to any group or partner.

clue.text: Cancel the Open

definitions.meaning: to reverse or annul an action, as with an editing command
to unfasten, as with a button or a parcel

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to reverse an action and to unfasten something that was tied or buttoned.

clue.text: Bitter and sour maple with crumbs of biccy

parts.note: Acer is the botanical genus of maples

indicators.note: crumbs are small pieces, so only a fragment of the word biccy is taken

explanation.surface: Tasting a tart maple-syrup treat sprinkled with biscuit crumbs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Biccy' is British slang for a biscuit; its first three letters are the crumbs used.
explanation.definitionFit: Acerbic describes a sharp, harsh taste, so it covers both bitter and sour.

clue.text: Sticks to sweet fruits

parts.note: read as sticks pushed into fruits that have been coated in a hard candy, the fairground treat

explanation.definitionFit: These treats are fruits on sticks covered in a sweet boiled-sugar coating.

clue.text: Present a good book to the first company that's organised

indicators.note: the company abbreviation is sent to the front of the other pieces

parts.note: to be present is to be here
NT is the New Testament, part of the Good Book

explanation.surface: Giving a fine Bible to the leading firm in an orderly fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Coherent argument is logically ordered, so organised is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Geological time the Executive Officer's seen, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the words must be spoken to give the sound of the answer

parts.note: EO is an Executive Officer; EO'S SEEN said aloud matches the epoch name

explanation.surface: An officer claiming to have witnessed a whole era.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eocene is an epoch of the Palaeogene period, a span of geological time.

clue.text: Lowest cipher

definitions.meaning: the bottom point on a scale
an old word for the figure nought

explanation.definitionFit: Nought is both the bottom of a scale and the meaning of cipher as a figure.

clue.text: Embrace foresight on the river

parts.note: ESP, extrasensory perception, includes seeing the future
the Ouse is a common crossword river in England

explanation.surface: Welcoming a clairvoyant vision by the riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ouse is a river in Yorkshire (and another in Sussex); 'on' joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse a cause is to embrace or adopt it.

clue.text: Drive goons wild by taking too many drugs

indicators.note: wild means out of control, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Driving thugs berserk by overindulging in narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: Overdosing is taking an excessive amount of a drug.

clue.text: Current death

parts.note: read as death caused by an electric current rather than a fashionable kind of death

explanation.definitionFit: An electric current can stop the heart, a fatal jolt of trauma.

clue.text: Record errors expected from sports equipment

parts.note: EP is an extended-play record
E is the scorebook abbreviation for an error in baseball
E stands for expected, as in expected value in statistics

explanation.surface: Logging the faults to be predicted from gym gear.
explanation.definitionFit: The fencing sword is a piece of sporting kit.

clue.text: Natant style involving heart massage

parts.note: the breast is traditionally the seat of the heart and feelings
to stroke is to rub gently

explanation.surface: A swimming technique that needs cardiac massage.
explanation.walkthrough: Natant means swimming or floating; 'involving' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a swimming stroke, and natant is a formal word for swimming.

clue.text: Clever sailor is attached to the French

parts.note: AB is an ...-bodied seaman
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A bright seaman has a fondness for France.
explanation.definitionFit: Able means skilled or capable, much like clever.

clue.text: Rush about to manage a period of boxing

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
a boxing match is fought in rounds

explanation.surface: Hurrying around to organise a bout of boxing.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving someone the runaround keeps them dashing about to no purpose.

clue.text: Musical piece of cutlery

parts.note: read as a two-pronged implement used for pitch, not for eating

explanation.definitionFit: The two-pronged steel device rings at a set pitch and looks like a dinner utensil.

clue.text: Lets loose the upper-class knight from his fetters

parts.note: N is knight in chess notation
fetters are chains

explanation.surface: A posh knight is freed from his shackles.
explanation.definitionFit: To release from chains is to set free or let loose.

clue.text: Charges for a second fondle!

parts.note: people in your charge are your cares

explanation.surface: Paying for a second cuddle.
explanation.definitionFit: To caress is to touch or stroke lovingly, to fondle.

clue.text: Every prophet partook in the unionist academy — 'Praise the Lord!'

parts.note: every one is all

indicators.note: to partake in is to take in, so the prophet holds the next piece

parts.note: Eli is the Old Testament priest-prophet

explanation.surface: Everyone at the unionist college joins in praising God.
explanation.definitionFit: This Hebrew exclamation literally means praise the Lord.

clue.text: Ingest mushroom with consuming interest

indicators.note: the abbreviation for interest swallows the mushroom

parts.note: INT is an abbreviation for interest
the cep is a prized edible mushroom

explanation.surface: Eating fungi with great enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology, to incept is to take in or swallow food.

clue.text: Moving picture concerning a lump of grey, brain matter

parts.note: cine relates to film
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A film about a chunk of grey brain tissue.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinerea is the anatomical term for the grey matter of the brain.

clue.text: Drunk inert ale — what a purgative!…

indicators.note: drunk means disordered, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Downing flat beer that works as a laxative.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaterin is a strong laxative obtained from the squirting cucumber.

clue.text: Boxer when in holiday surroundings became a pragmatist

indicators.note: puts the boxer inside the holiday word

parts.note: a rest is a holiday or break
Muhammad Ali, the famous boxer

explanation.surface: A boxer on holiday becomes practical-minded.
explanation.definitionFit: A realist deals with things as they are, as a pragmatist does.

clue.text: Beaten by Brown and Sherrin

parts.note: tan is a light brown colour
Ned Sherrin was a British broadcaster and satirist

explanation.surface: Defeated by a man named Brown and another named Sherrin.
explanation.walkthrough: Ned Sherrin was a well-known British TV and radio presenter.
explanation.definitionFit: To tan someone's hide is to beat them.

clue.text: …and fifty agreeing to mix the drink…

indicators.note: mixing stirs the letters into a new order

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty people agree to mix the drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: This fizzy ginger-flavoured soft drink is often used as a mixer.

clue.text: …and returns a portion of gin

indicators.note: the word is turned back to front

parts.note: a part is a portion

explanation.surface: Coming back for a share of gin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gin' is not the spirit here but a snare for animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin is a trap for catching game.

clue.text: Catch sight of East Samoa's original little pygmy

indicators.note: the original letter is the first one
a little piece of the word is kept, the rest cut away

explanation.surface: Spotting a small Pacific islander.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of something.

clue.text: Odd oratress has rows

explanation.surface: A strange woman speaker gets into arguments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rows' looks like quarrels, but here it is the verb to row.
explanation.definitionFit: To oar is a poetic verb for rowing a boat.

clue.text: Income spun from synthesising medicines

indicators.note: synthesising builds something new, so the letters are recombined

explanation.surface: Earnings spun out of making drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Pneumonics are medicines for diseases of the lungs.

clue.text: Rap Kelvin and knock over

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin
to pan is to criticise or knock

explanation.surface: Striking Kelvin and knocking him down.
explanation.definitionFit: To knap is to strike sharply, a rap or knock.

clue.text: Can lady jet off in a conterminous manner?

indicators.note: off suggests the letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Can a woman fly off along a shared border?
explanation.definitionFit: Conterminous means sharing a boundary, so adjacently is next to each other.
